snippet.title: Kkokko Industry // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489220/Kkokko_Industry/

Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

Developed by 
Tesseract Studio, Nugem Studio
